BSD-3-Clause structure whose third clause is worded "The names of any contributors may not be used to endorse or promote products derived from this software without specific prior written permission" instead of the SPDX "Neither the name of ..." wording, followed by a pointer to the uri-js contributor list; manual review found no additional restriction. package.json and the npm registry declare MIT, but LICENSE.txt (identical in the upstream repository at the published gitHead ca0fb63) ends the grant with "subject to the following conditions:" and states none, so it is neither the SPDX MIT nor the SPDX MIT-0 text. Treated conservatively as MIT: copyright and permission notice retained here.
